sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Full screen min-h-screen relative flex items-center justify-center. Hero background image with bg-black/40 overlay. Text is vertically centered.
sections.typography: H1 text-white Playfair Display. Subtitle text-white/90 Manrope. Use Tracking-tight for H1.

sections.name: About Brand & FPO
sections.layout: Asymmetric bento grid (Tetris Mode). 12-column grid. Left side: large image of farmers. Right side: Text block explaining Ruwan Agro & Rupwara Marwan FPO mission.

sections.name: Products Overview
sections.layout: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Minimalist product cards.
sections.style: Images take 70% height, text below. No background, just crisp 1px borders.

sections.name: Farmer Network Impact
sections.layout: Dark section bg-[#2C402E] text-white. Large statistics numbers.
sections.elements: Use 'Editorial Ribbon' marquee running in the background with text like 'EMPOWERING BIHAR FARMERS • DIRECT FROM SOURCE •'.

sections.name: Sustainability & Why Choose Us
sections.layout: 2-column layout. One side image (sustainability), other side bulleted list of value props with custom icons (lucide-react).
sections.style: Terracotta accents #9E4723 for icons and borders.

sections.name: Contact & Footer
sections.layout: Generous spacing py-24. 2 columns: Left side Contact info (address, phone, email). Right side Shadcn form customized for the theme.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses text-shadow or appropriate overlay (bg-black/40). All form inputs must have aria-labels.
accessibility.interactions: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling, avoid raw CSS where possible.
Do NOT use HTML <input> or <form> directly for complex parts; use Shadcn UI components but heavily override them to match the Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) style.
Do NOT use Inter font for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Do NOT use a generic blue/purple CTA. Use the Forest Green (#2C402E) or Terracotta (#9E4723).
Hero image MUST have a max overlay opacity of bg-black/40.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute.
The grid must use CSS grid with wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12).
Implement 'Editorial Ribbon' marquee for the Farmer Impact section using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee.
